features.description: HTTP pipeline classifies the shipped tickets through the gateway
Subprocess pipeline classifies the shipped tickets with a Python client
Four shipped support tickets, T-001 to T-004
Replay-only gateway on 127.0.0.1:18157 with the demo-kit wire contract, no live mode
Committed recorded answers replayed instead of calling a model
Runner exits 0 by itself after four records with no warning lines
A ticket with no recorded answer becomes an error record in both pipelines
Cloud node with the gateway colocated: deploy/docker-compose.node.yaml
Dated Markdown run report written by scripts/prove.py
just gateway-up, gateway-status and gateway-down for recording replacement answers
Comparison of building the request in YAML or in a Python client
